components.name: alert
components.title: Alert
components.description: An inline message that stays in the page: status, warnings, errors, or context the user should read before acting. For transient feedback use Toast instead.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
components.description: Image or initials for a person or entity. Falls back to initials automatically when there is no image or it fails to load, with a stable per-name background hue.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: Small status label. Three variants and six tones cover statuses, counts and categories; a `dot` adds a status indicator.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: The primary action control. Renders a `<button>` by default, or an `<a>` when `href` is given, with identical styling in both cases. Five visual variants × three tones × three sizes cover every button in a typical app without custom CSS.

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: A surface that groups related content. Three variants (outlined, elevated, filled), optional header and footer rows, and an interactive mode for clickable cards.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: A native checkbox with a custom box. Supports an indeterminate state for "select all" and an optional description line.

components.name: container
components.title: Container
components.description: Centres content with a max width from the `--container-*` scale and page-level horizontal padding.

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: A modal window built on Bits UI's Dialog: focus is trapped, the page behind is inert and scroll-locked, Escape and overlay clicks close it (unless `dismissible={false}`), and focus returns to the trigger on close.

components.name: divider
components.title: Divider
components.description: A hairline separator, horizontal or vertical, with an optional centred label.

components.name: field
components.title: Field
components.description: Wraps a form control with a label, optional hint and error message, and wires the accessibility attributes for you: the label's `for`, the control's `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, `required` and `disabled` all flow through context.

components.name: grid
components.title: Grid
components.description: CSS grid with two modes: a fixed column count, or responsive auto-fit columns with a minimum width. Both keep a token-driven gap.

components.name: heading
components.title: Heading
components.description: Semantic heading (h1–h6) in the theme's display face. Visual size is decoupled from the level so document outlines stay correct while the design does what it needs.

components.name: inline
components.title: Inline
components.description: Horizontal flex layout that wraps by default. Use for button rows, tag clouds, toolbars and metadata lines.

components.name: input
components.title: Input
components.description: Single-line text input with optional leading/trailing adornments. Reads label, hint, error, required and disabled from a surrounding Field.

components.name: menu
components.title: Menu
components.description: A dropdown menu of actions, built on Bits UI's DropdownMenu: arrow-key navigation, typeahead, focus return and dismissal are handled for you. Compose it from `Menu`, `MenuItem`, `MenuCheckboxItem`, `MenuGroup` and `MenuSeparator`.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: A floating panel anchored to its trigger, for filters, pickers, small forms and previews. Positioning, collision avoidance, focus management and dismissal come from Bits UI.

components.name: radio
components.title: Radio & RadioGroup
components.description: Single choice from a small set. `RadioGroup` owns the value, name, label, hint and error; `Radio` renders one option and reads the group through context.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.description: A single-choice dropdown built on Bits UI's Select, styled to match Input. Takes a flat `items` array (optionally grouped), works inside Field, and submits through a hidden input when given a `name`.

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: Loading placeholder that mirrors the shape of the content it stands in for. Hidden from assistive technology; announce loading with `aria-busy` on the region instead.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner
components.description: Indeterminate loading indicator. Inherits `currentColor` and scales with font size, so it drops into buttons, inputs and text without configuration.

components.name: stack
components.title: Stack
components.description: Vertical flex layout with a token-driven gap. The default way to space things top-to-bottom; reach for it before writing `margin`.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: An on/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately. Use a Checkbox instead when the choice is submitted with a form.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: Switch between sections of related content. Built on Bits UI's Tabs for roving focus and ARIA wiring; compose it from `Tabs`, `TabList`, `Tab` and `TabPanel`.

components.name: text
components.title: Text
components.description: Body text with size, weight and tone from tokens. Also handles the recurring needs of application text: tabular numerals, truncation and line clamping.

components.name: textarea
components.title: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line text input. Optional auto-resize grows with content instead of scrolling.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: Transient notifications. Call `toast()` from anywhere (components, load functions, stores) and render one `<Toaster />` near the root of the app. Toasts auto-dismiss, pause while hovered or focused, and are announced through a polite live region.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: A short label shown on hover or keyboard focus. For icon-only buttons and truncated text — never for content the user needs to act on.
